method: Conservative machine-vision review of local rights-restricted source/Q3/Q7 contact sheets; not a blinded human panel and not scan authorization.

summary.meaningful_or_subtle: Mostly subtle-to-moderate mask/composition changes rather than a new visual style.

observations: Q7 generally makes the intended silhouette slightly more coherent or centered while preserving finder/quiet-zone visibility.
Readable changes are frequently subtle because scan-safe black modules dominate by design.
Balanced and Image-first show the clearest directional contour changes, especially on the J, M, and geometric marks.
The dense QR grid still dominates every artifact; fine text, brand typography, facial detail, and thin calligraphy remain materially degraded.
No panel qualifies as premium sponsor-faithful artwork. Q7 is a safer deterministic selector improvement, not a sponsor-readiness breakthrough.
